title: Assert SQLite WAL mode concurrency stability
task_summary: Assured that SQLite connections utilize WAL mode and busy timeouts of 5000ms. Implemented a highly-stressed, multi-session parallel write test to assert zero database lock-contention exceptions occur under realistic concurrent workloads.

files_changed.change: Added test_concurrent_database_writes verifying deadlock-free concurrent writes under WAL mode.

assumptions_verified.verification: Confirmed WAL mode configuration is fully active on connections.
Validated through test_concurrent_database_writes that overlapping parallel inserts work perfectly without lock errors.

decisions.reasoning: A 5-second timeout is a very reasoned value that allows any brief lock-contention to queue and resolve smoothly in highly concurrent async scenarios, while failing fast enough during true application hangs.

self_review.checked: All modified files, schema, and test executions.

notes_for_next_step: Step 10 is fully completed and thoroughly verified. SQLite WAL mode and busy timeout are perfectly reliable under load.
